purpose: Validate change identity, full-state branch pairing, separate policy execution and bounded whole-scenario loss accounting; no population-improvement claim.

baseline.assets: Must pin existing permitted checkpoint/manifest hashes before launch

transform: Scale only the finite outgoing velocity before existing environment actuation; retain native heading. Pin exact clipping semantics and state serialization in adapter source before launch. No extra privileged observations.

sampling.unit: one whole fresh developmental scenario with all four conditions
sampling.distribution: Not yet pinned; must freeze factory config and a draw mechanism independent of pilot outcomes, with protected held-out banks excluded.
sampling.pairing: Create one full initial snapshot per scenario; restore identical simulator/controller/RNG/application state for each separately executed policy condition. Baseline and candidates must actually invoke FLYNN.

loss.definition: For plumbing only: 0 if the declared goal predicate is reached within64ticks,1 otherwise. Infrastructure/integrity failure is a separate failed unit, never silently dropped or counted as task loss.

launch_gates: Pin adapter source and serialization including gain and native actuation clipping
Pin all runtime/model/asset identities and permissible use
Freeze developmental scenario factory/draw identity; exclude protected held-out datasets
Verify fresh-state pairing and separate policy execution without replay substitution
Verify current free space and all output reservations before every unit
stopping: Stop after first timeout, identity/sampling violation or cap breach. Preserve all failures and partials. No retries or extra seeds under this protocol.
next_research_audit: Separate protocol required after pilot review. Freeze candidate family and baseline, target distribution, bounded full-episode loss, alpha, fixed horizon or fixed betting scale, exclusions and finite allocation before any audit outcomes. Pilot is never counted as held-out audit data.
